name: frozen
description: A header-only, constexpr alternative to gperf for C++14 users (overlay: pinned to the post-1.2.0 commit that LIEF 1.0.0 vendors).

Why an overlay exists: the vcpkg baseline ships the v1.2.0 tag (2024-06-02); LIEF 1.0.0's tree vendors commit 61dce5a (2025-07-29), whose headers differ in six files (constexpr assertions in carray, constexpr_assert, pmh, map, set, string, unordered_map). Per the alignment rule the overlay carries the commit LIEF ships. port-version 1 records that this is a post-release snapshot rather than a packaging revision of v1.2.0.
